subject: Annual prepay staircase: invoice cadence, drawdown triggers & VAT evidence
messages:
From: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@brightlane.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance-ops@brightlane.com
Date: 2029-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Annual prepay and drawdown plan — starter ask

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the demo last week. Finance here needs to lock down the invoicing cadence and drawdown process for the annual prepay (committed spend) we discussed — Brightlane is targeting an upfront commitment that will be drawn down monthly across the year. Two asks to start:

1) Can you share a proposed invoice cadence (when we receive invoices for the prepay and for monthly drawdowns) and a suggested bank/payment remittance flow?
2) We need VAT evidence for our EU operations — specifically Sweden (we’ll route invoices to our Swedish branch). Can you provide the certificate(s) Redwood requires on file?

Also include any sample invoice numbering format and a short checklist your AP team needs before payment (PO number, remit account, contact). I attached our purchase order draft (PO_7890_Brightlane.pdf).

Available for a 30-min sync this week if useful.

Thanks —
Marta
Director, Finance Operations
Brightlane

Attachments: PO_7890_Brightlane.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay and drawdown plan — starter ask

Hi Marta —

Great to hear — below is a pragmatic proposal we use for similar committed spend customers. I kept it intentionally concrete so your AP/treasury can action it quickly.

Proposal (summary):
- Upfront commitment: single invoice for the committed amount (issued on contract activation).
- Amortization cadence: Redwood will amortize the committed amount monthly for internal accounting; for Brightlane we will issue drawdown invoices when monthly consumption crosses the drawdown threshold.
- Drawdown threshold: default is 15% of monthly committed value or when running prepay balance dips below 20% of committed balance — we can set lower/higher per your risk preference.
- Invoice cadence:
  * Activation invoice: immediate, net 30 (for accounting/PO match).
  * Monthly usage/drawdown invoices: issued on the 5th business day of each month for prior month consumption and any triggered drawdowns.
  * Ad-hoc top-up invoices if balance triggers occur mid-month.
- VAT routing: invoice to Brightlane Sweden AB; we will include Redwood's EU VAT MOSS references and attach Redwood's VAT certificate for Sweden.

Operational checklist (what we need from Brightlane):
- Final PO number (you already sent PO_7890 — confirm final PO#).
- Confirmation of legal entity for invoicing (Brightlane Sweden AB) and VAT ID.
- Bank remit instructions or ERP vendor code.

I attached: prepay_schedule_template.xlsx and a sample invoice (sample_invoice_BR-2029Q1.pdf). Neha has added VAT notes below. Vivek, I’ve looped you for ops handoff and the HubSpot/deal tracking link.

If that plan looks good I’ll generate the activation invoice and a DocuSign cover for the SOW+billing appendix. Meeting: I can be available Thu 10:00–11:00 PT for a quick ops review.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Partner Finance 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prepay_schedule_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample_invoice_BR-2029Q1.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Marta / Sofia,

Quick VAT operational notes for routing invoices to Sweden:
- Invoice to: Brightlane Sweden AB; include their Swedish VAT number (please confirm exact format).
- Redwood will attach our EU VAT certificate and include the VAT registration number on each invoice. For EU intra-community B2B, we will zero-rate VAT where you provide a valid EU VAT ID — otherwise standard Swedish VAT applies.
- Evidence we’ll store: PO, signed SOW, Brightlane VAT registration screenshot, and the remit account confirmation (bank statement stub once first payment clears).

Attached: Brightlane_VAT_cert_SE.pdf (template for our records). Please upload your VAT registration doc to the secure link I’ll send after you confirm the entity.

Neha
Tax & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightlane_VAT_cert_SE.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — that cadence seems reasonable. A couple of clarifications:

- Drawdown threshold: we prefer a smaller buffer; can we set trigger to 10% of committed amount and monthly sweep on the 3rd business day?
- PO: final PO is PO_7890 (confirmed).
- Bank remit: we will use the remit account on the PO; can you confirm Redwood’s bank account name and swift/BIC in the activation invoice?

If you send the activation invoice + DocuSign, I’ll get the payment queued. We will also upload our Swedish VAT registration in the secure uploader you mentioned.

— Marta
